fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Mechanized Wheeled Points use wheeled armored vehicles that balance speed and protection better than hovercraft or motorcycles. Effective on developed road networks and open terrain, they sacrifice the all-terrain capability of tracked vehicles for better sustained speed on firm ground. Fitted with dedicated anti-aircraft weapons alongside standard rifles, these Points provide point air defense for infantry formations and fixed installations, screening against low-flying VTOLs and conventional aircraft.
